content.json:
# Trading bot

Paper trading only. Every number here comes from the bot's own structured logs, so the panels and the alerts read the same source: if a panel is empty, the alert that depends on it is blind too.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "trading-cycle"
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) == "cycle.completed"
| project TimeGenerated, Equity = todouble(payload.equity_quote)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Equity curve

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "trading-cycle"
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) == "cycle.completed"
| project TimeGenerated, Drawdown = todouble(payload.drawdown_ratio)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Intraday drawdown against the day's opening equity

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "trading-cycle"
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) == "cycle.decision"
| summarize Cycles = count() by Outcome = tostring(payload.outcome), Reason = tostring(payload.reason)
| order by Cycles desc
content.title: Why the bot did what it did

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "trading-cycle"
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) == "cycle.executed"
| project TimeGenerated, ClientOrderId = tostring(payload.client_order_id), Status = tostring(payload.status), Quantity = tostring(payload.filled_quantity), Fees = tostring(payload.fees_quote)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Recent orders

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s == "trading-cycle"
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) == "cycle.completed"
| summarize LastCycle = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend MinutesSinceLastCycle = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastCycle)
content.title: Minutes since the last completed cycle

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerName_s in ("trading-cycle", "migrate")
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where tostring(payload.message) in ("cycle.failed", "cycle.crashed")
| project TimeGenerated, Message = tostring(payload.message), ErrorType = tostring(payload.error_type), Error = tostring(payload.error)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 20
content.title: Failures
